authority: VM 4.4.0 Build20250516 decompiled assemblies and XAML

shared_layers.responsibility: shared feature-model list, create/edit/delete commands, model selection, image preview, model data decoration and common panel resources
feature-match parameter root, common template dialog behavior, shared image/mask interaction shell, parameter templates and bottom command integration

tool_specializations.note: MarkFind has a separate custom panel and dialog path, so it must not be forced into the FeatureMatch adapter without evidence.

confirmed_lifecycle: CreateModel creates an independent 900x534 BaseWindow and sets the tool dialog as its content.
New model acquires current image, binds dialog events, shows modally, then adds model data to the module on dialog success.
Edit model validates selected model and source image, deep-copies old data for rollback, refreshes dialog state, shows modally, and restores the copy when cancelled.
LoadModel decrypts and parses the model file, supports old and SDK roots, restores UI data and adds the model to the list.
Feature model list, preview, edit, delete and ordering are common panel responsibilities, while model encoding and file extension are tool adapters.
Progress mask, help command, bottom commands and close result belong to the parameter root/dialog shell.

do_not_generalize: Do not treat every feature tool as a clone of ContourMatch. GrayMatch shares FeatureMatchCommonControl but has a different dialog and config data type.
Do not force MarkFind into the shared FeatureMatch panel without matching runtime or static evidence.
Do not replace model dialog lifecycle with a normal parameter row.
Do not infer original resource or command semantics from the generic self-owned renderer.
